summary: Create AI avatar, talking-head, and lip-sync videos on RunComfy via the `runcomfy` CLI. Routes across ByteDance OmniHuman (audio-driven full-body avatar), Wan-AI Wan 2-7 (audio-driven mouth sync via `audio_url` on a portrait), HappyHorse 1.0 (Arena #1 t2v / i2v with in-pass audio), and Seedance…
